Subject: POC activation: align dates & success criteria

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We discussed running a short POC to validate latency under your average request patterns and prove cost per 1M tokens in your production-like environment. To get the POC into motion we need to lock a kickoff that brings the right stakeholders together (AE, SE, your platform eng, procurement, and security).

Proposed objectives for the kickoff (30–45m):
- Confirm success criteria (latency buckets, throughput target, data boundaries)
- Walkthrough technical pre-reqs (networking, VPC peering, sample traffic)
- Agree timeline and owners for the 2-week POC
- Procurement checkpoint: purchase order / reseller confirmation

I have availability next week for a kickoff: Mon 11/22 10:00–11:00 PT, Tue 11/23 14:00–15:00 PT, or Mon 11/29 09:00–10:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple windows and we will adapt.

I attached a one-page draft agenda (agenda-v1.pdf) and a short POC success criteria doc (POC-success-criteria.docx) for your review.

Owners we propose:
- AE: Camila Reyes (me) — coordination, commercial
- SE: Ben Carter — implementation and test plan
- Redwood security/ops: Marissa Cole (cc) — compliance checklist

Please confirm who from FinRight will need to join (engineering, procurement, security contact). If procurement needs a specific PO or reseller data, include them on the reply.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Camila Reyes
